boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 121 splits the board into a blue-and-yellow upper conveyor and a lower checkerboard grid, connected by a feed lane. The upper tray must drain completely before the green `31` crown block in the lower grid unlocks. The right-side `5` arrow tile is the last gatekeeper — clear it too late and the crown stays boxed in even after the conveyor is empty.
landmarks: Block Out Level 121 splits the board into a blue-and-yellow upper conveyor and a lower checkerboard grid, connected by a feed lane.
The upper tray must drain completely before the green `31` crown block in the lower grid unlocks.
The right-side `5` arrow tile is the last gatekeeper — clear it too late and the crown stays boxed in even after the conveyor is empty.

quickTips: Drain the upper tray completely before chasing the green `31` crown.
Keep the lower cyan `19` column parked until the upper tray goes dark.
If the board feels stuck, look for the color with the cleanest path and use that to regain space.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Feed the upper blue/yellow checkerboard through the right-side yellow arrows into the lower tray.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the upper red `23` row and the left-edge cyan `7` badge until the upper tray goes dark.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Peel the lower red/orange/green top cap without touching the center white `15` slot.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Break the green `31` crown block once the left cyan `19` column opens a lane.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Spend the blue `10` tile and the right-side `5` arrow counter before the yellow stacks thin.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the bottom cyan `26` counter and the remaining blue/yellow scraps for the PERFECT clear.

failurePoints: Chasing the green `31` crown before the upper tray is fully dark — this boxes the center `15` slot.
Clearing yellow stacks before the blue `10` tile moves, sealing the bottom cyan `26` counter.
